Before the iPod even existed, the Sony Walkman was already the top pick for people who wanted music to go with their lives. Now the Duo-Man app recreates that experience, letting those of us who once owned a Walkman relive those golden years — and you can even use it together with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, people had very limited choices for listening to music on the go. Most cassette players at the time were big and bulky. Sony shrunk a recorder originally designed for journalists down to the smallest possible size, turning it into the most compact cassette player around — and it quickly became an icon.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app at a hackathon. Since many people there had never actually seen a real Walkman, he特意帶咗一部實物去，等大家可以睇吓佢到底係乜樣。

You open Duo, pick the album you want to put into the cassette, then close the lid and the music starts playing.

Bhargava says he originally built this demo app just for fun, but has now decided to release it properly. The best reply under his X post was an image that only people of a certain age will truly understand.
